entries.en: During battle, it is possible to[n]support your allies.
This takes one turn, but providing[n]support will increase defense as[n]well as other ally-specific effects.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji, Lady Ann! Don't push yourselves.[n]I'll take care of the rest!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But now it's my turn! Let's go, Joker!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's go for you-know-what!
Supporting allies lets you execute[n]Unison Skills. These are powerful[n]and cost SP, but scoring One More[n]will remove most of the costs.
